definition: `PriorSimply y x`: y is prior to x simply, not in time: whatever is in potency in a respect presupposes some being in act in that respect, because potency is reduced to act only by a being in act. It is a dependence relation distinct from present moving. Whether simple priority makes y a cause of x's being is not part of this definition: that is the open premise STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING.
